\cvsection{Introduction}
I am a third-year Ph.D. student in Computer Science at Rutgers University with nearly 4 years of experience in robot learning and planning. My research spans 3D scene understanding, object rearrangement, dynamic manipulation, and model-based reinforcement learning for humanoid locomotion. I have published at CoRL and IROS. My current research focuses on planning with learned world models for robust humanoid loco-manipulation. I also study Q-guided planning for vision-language-action (VLA) policies.

Under review.}{\resource{https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39751}{Paper}\enspace \resource{https://pl-mpc-humanoid.github.io/}{Project}\enspace \resource{https://github.com/Kowndinya2000/pl-mpc}{Code}}{\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=12pt,label=\textbullet,itemsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,topsep=2pt]\item Combined uncertainty-aware MPPI planning with value learning and policy distillation using learned world models; improved mean return over the TD-M(PC)\squared{} baseline from 98 to 387 on balance-hard and from 199 to 466 on hurdle with Unitree H1 in HumanoidBench (MuJoCo).
\item Demonstrated zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of a learned world model coupled with an MPPI planner from Isaac Gym to a KUKA IIWA14 for tool manipulation on a challenging wrench--nut alignment task.\end{itemize}}
\paper{https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38857}{Plan-Conditioned Imitation for Robust Object Retrieval under Self-Occlusion in Dense Clutter}{\textbf{Kowndinya Boyalakuntla}, Ajinkya Pawar, Abdeslam Boularias, Jingjin Yu}{Manuscript, 2026. Under review.}{\resource{https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38857}{Paper}\enspace \resource{https://trace-retrieval.github.io/}{Project}\enspace \resource{https://github.com/Kowndinya2000/trace-code}{Code}\enspace \resource{https://huggingface.co/datasets/Kowndi/trace}{Data}}{\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=12pt,label=\textbullet,itemsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,topsep=2pt]\item Developed a plan-conditioned imitation policy that rearranges dense clutter to create grasping clearance even when the robot's arm blocks the camera's view, with potential applications in bin picking and assembly-kit retrieval.
\item Achieved 90.7\% retrieval success in Isaac Gym simulation and 90\% after sim-to-real transfer to UR5e, cutting hardware task time by 65\% versus the full-observation planner.\end{itemize}}
\paper{https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11245879}{KARL: Kalman-Filter Assisted Reinforcement Learner for Dynamic Object Tracking and Grasping}{\textbf{Kowndinya Boyalakuntla}, Abdeslam Boularias, Jingjin Yu}{IROS, 2025}{\resource{https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11245879}{Paper}\enspace \resource{https://github.com/arc-l/karl}{Code}}{\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=12pt,label=\textbullet,itemsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,topsep=2pt]\item Combined curriculum reinforcement learning in Isaac Gym with Kalman-filter tracking for dynamic grasping and failure recovery through object reacquisition and grasp retries.
\item Demonstrated sim-to-real transfer to UR5e, achieving 93.3\% grasp success in unobstructed scenes and 80\% with obstacles, outperforming \href{https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10341988/}{\underline{EARL}} in both settings.\end{itemize}}
